protocol.kind: pre-execution source observations for all original Core560, not model evaluation or semantic repair
protocol.selection: All and only original Core560 IDs shared by answer_contract.jsonl and core_answer_gold.jsonl; all outcomes retained, no score-based exclusion or task replacement
protocol.original_inputs: Pin the original benchmark624, questions624, answer_contract560, Core gold identity file, track assignment and all560 annotated Cypher source files before execution. Preserve question/reference UTF-8 value hashes, source line hashes and original answer-contract metadata.
protocol.reference_query: Execute the exact benchmark.jsonl cypher string. Annotated .cypher file hashes are retained separately; comments/trailing newlines mean its complete file bytes need not equal the benchmark value. No trim, normalization, rewriting, variant or alias repair.
protocol.row_cap_detection: Observe 2001st row to mark ROW_CAP; retain at most2000 rows. Capped and failed observations are never certified complete.
protocol.wall_budget_limit: Stop launching after1740s, then wait for bounded in-flight reads and source guards. Actual tail duration is recorded; remaining original IDs remain NOT_EXECUTED_WALL_BUDGET rather than excluded.
protocol.graphs: Only the five owned archival TTL restorations at fixed loopback ports57687..57691. Import source hashes, inventory, owner/run/source container guard and before/after node+relationship counts are pinned; current research graphs are never adopted.
protocol.guard: Reuse pinned anonymous-CALL lexical screen, ownership guard, EXPLAIN query_type r with non-updating plan, explicit READ session/30s transaction, final ordinary-read summary when fully consumed, rollback in every path. Procedure calls, writes and system commands are prohibited. READ routing alone is not a security certificate.
protocol.json_value_handling: Access original record positions directly. JSON-simple exact built-in str/bool/int/finitefloat/null/list/string-key dict values only. Preserve positional row arrays and native column order, including duplicate names. No Record.data(), entity/path/temporal tuple coercion or string fallback. Unsupported rows retain type observations, not fabricated JSON answers.
protocol.outputs: Stream JSON-simple rows to exclusive per-item JSONL, plus original-question sidecar, native column names/positions, observed native datatypes, observed null counts/array element types, execution status/cap/rollback/source provenance. Type and nullability observations are not guaranteed schema constraints. Partial rows and unsupported rows are explicit; no incomplete result is declared complete.
protocol.syntax: Analysis-only top-level RETURN/ORDER BY/SKIP/LIMIT/UNION raw clauses and offsets. These syntactic observations do not infer requested roles, full-question scope, cardinality, tie policy, stable order or semantic collection type. Original annotation labels are historical source metadata, not new certificates.

official_sources.basis: Record.data() can lose native graph/spatial/temporal datatype information; installed driver5.28.3 docstring also checked.
RETURN expresses query projections, not a certificate that the natural-language question asks every returned field.
ORDER BY is syntactic ordering evidence; tie uniqueness and task semantics still require separate definition.
Anonymous subqueries are distinguished from procedure calls by the reused previously verified gate.

interpretation_limits: Operational source-contract applicability only; not domain-expert validation, semantic certification, repaired-original answer coverage or performance.
All560 original IDs remain in the report regardless of execution status, row cap, unsupported native type or wall-budget nonexecution.
Query-returned fields, types, null counts and source rows do not establish that all natural-language requirements are represented.
Empty output supplies no observed native value type; absent nulls do not certify non-nullability.
Syntactic order/limit evidence alone does not establish deterministic ties or a semantic collection contract.
Before/after inventories do not detect same-count property edits; no such detection is claimed.
Source execution over restored deposited graphs need not equal historical outputs from other source snapshots.
No new model generation, historical-score replacement, expert certificate, outside-RAN result or validated abstention result is produced.
